title: Gap between the clues off by 1-3 letters: formula mining (54, sizes 0-3) and the three-keyword Quagmire IV hash join (63, key lengths 1-20)
k4_result: Formulas: 0 fits with 8+ checks out of 25,743,168 (4,290,528 per shift, shifts -3..+3 without 0). Join: 666,993 alphabets per side; 13,091 consistent settings over the six shifts, all at key lengths 15-20 (5-9 checks, the number chance predicts); best partial decrypt -5.95 (gibberish on reading); 0 settings whose key can be a dictionary word
controls: 2 shuffled K4s per shift. Formulas: 0 fits each. Join: 12,254 and 452 consistent settings, best partial decrypts -5.97 and -5.96, 0 word keys each
scope_limits: Shifts -3..+3 only, with the slip assumed between observed positions 39 and 57 (a slip at 34-38 or 58-62 changes neighbour-ciphertext ingredients with lags up to 5 and is not covered for formulas using them). Formulas: sizes 0-3 only (no size 4), attack 54's 186-ingredient library, A-Z/KRYPTOS alphabets, 8+ checks; all ingredients including the carved-layout ones are taken at the encipherer's (shifted) positions, so a formula mixing shifted positions with the observed copper layout is not covered. Join: key lengths 1-20 (not 21-24), attack 63's dictionary keyword alphabets and their two transposition mixes, Vigenere/Beaufort; at key lengths 17-20 with some shifts there are only 5-7 checks, so thousands of chance matches exist and were judged only by partial-decrypt score (letters in the 39-57 stretch left out) and the dictionary-word key test, not ruled out one by one. Planted formula answers were searched on the small library (grid widths 7 and 31). Only 2 controls per shift.

negative.family: gap slack: formula keys and Quagmire IV
negative.hypothesis: A short linear key formula, or a three-keyword Quagmire IV, fits the clues once the second clue is moved by 1-3 places because letters were lost or added between the clues.
negative.scope: Second clue at 63+g..73+g for g = -3,-2,-1,+1,+2,+3. Formulas C = a*P + up to 3 of 186 ingredients + c mod 26 (A-Z/KRYPTOS, 8+ checks), 25.7 million formulas.
